outcome: Lower uterine segment (LUS) thickness during active labor
cohort: 57 women in active labor (28 with a previous cesarean delivery and 29 without)
finding: LUS thickness was significantly thinner in women with a previous cesarean section during active labor, both during and between contractions.
mod_finding: LUS thickness was significantly thinner in women with a previous cesarean section during active labor, both during and between contractions.
